prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high (except round 11), while negative predictions were too low as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -2.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.9% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Warning Banner: Displays an explicit hint on the sign-in screen advising returning users to sign in with their original account provider to avoid losing existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again using a different authentication method.)
1: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Interactive Mascot Animation: Redesigns the waiting screen layout to a carousel with an interactive mascot animation while the pet generation completes in the background. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and a mean of 2336s, causing significant user drop-off.)
2: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Shortcut Overlay Hint: Adds a hint on the home intro screen detailing shortcut hotkeys for controlling, showing, and hiding the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the desktop pet.)
3: [sign_in, incentive] Sign In Account Persistence Badge: Adds an account persistence badge reassuring users that pet progress is safely backed up to their account. (why: 8 support tickets cited pets disappearing due to account sign-in ambiguity.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Audio Preview Component: Adds sound preview components to the pick friend screen allowing users to listen to pet voice samples before selection. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a mean duration of 1017s during pet selection.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Hatching Progress Stage Counter: Displays an active progress bar with step counters on the waiting screen to give real-time visibility into generation stages. (why: The home waiting screen has a mean duration of 2336s and 81.3% conversion, showing impatience during loading.)
6: [finish, new_screen] Home Intro Quick Controls Checklist: Inserts a new screen 'new_controls_summary' after home intro featuring an interactive checklist of basic desktop pet controls. (why: Support receives multiple tickets post-onboarding from users who are confused about how to interact with or hide their pet.)
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality Guidelines Component: Adds a clear photo quality tip carousel and hint to the photo upload screen to help users provide clear inputs. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual glitches.)
8: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Screen Mascot Welcome Header: Redesigns the choose_path screen layout to stage view with an animated mascot introducing path choices. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating users need clearer, more engaging visual hierarchy.)
